feeds.title: Tesco PLC news
feeds.description: Tesco PLC is one of the world's largest retailers of consumer goods from food to fashion. Serving customers a little better every day in our stores and online is at the heart of everything we do. This site provides all the news and information about Tesco PLC.

feeds.title: Tesco Labs
feeds.description: Tesco Technology is made up of people from several different backgrounds with a shared interest in harnessing innovations in technology. Tesco Labs is here to help you experience the future. We are here to envisage, design and create the future Tesco.
